class.name: OSKernel
class.brief_description: The per-world OpenDust OS kernel: world drive, app registry, sessions, message bus.
class.description: Exactly one [OSKernel] exists per running world. It is created lazily by the first [Device] or [Device2D] that enters the tree (added under the scene tree root as [code]OpenDustOSKernel[/code]) and found with [method get_singleton]. The kernel owns the [WorldDrive] (a real directory, [code]user://opendust/worlds/<world_id>/drive[/code] by default, configurable with the [code]opendust/os/drive_root[/code] project setting), the app registry (built-in apps plus scenes registered with [method register_app]), the per-device session (a local session until pods.global SSO lands) and the message bus. Messages are addressed to durable ids (a device id, a user id, an agent id or a display name), never to node paths. An undeliverable message is queued against its id and redelivered when a matching device registers. See [code]docs/opendust/03-os-layer.md[/code].

method.name: get_singleton
method.description: Returns the kernel of the running world, or [code]null[/code] if no device has entered the tree yet.

method.name: get_world_id
method.description: The world id, from the [code]opendust/world_id[/code] project setting.

method.name: get_drive_root
method.description: Absolute filesystem path of the world drive.

method.name: get_drive
method.description: The world drive shared by every device in this world.

method.name: get_identity
method.description: The identity consumer. Phase 0: local session only.

method.name: register_app
method.description: Registers a scene as an app. The scene root must be a [Control]; if it extends [OSApp] (or has a [code]setup(context)[/code] method) it receives an [OSAppContext] when opened.

method.name: list_apps
method.description: Returns [code][{id, title, builtin}][/code]. Built-in apps are [code]os.home[/code], [code]os.files[/code], [code]os.notes[/code] and [code]os.messages[/code].

method.name: get_session_for
method.description: The session signed in on a device: [code]{family_id, user_id, display_name, scopes, source}[/code].

method.name: get_devices
method.description: Returns [code][{device_id, node_path, awake, session, room_id}][/code] for every registered device.

method.name: send
method.description: Sends [code]{from?, to, body, attachments?}[/code] on the bus. Returns [code]{id, queued, delivered}[/code]. [code]to[/code] is a durable id. Delivery failure is a state, not an error: the message is queued and redelivered later.

method.name: get_history
method.description: The most recent messages seen by the bus (delivered or queued), oldest first.

signal.name: message_received
signal.description: Emitted when a message is delivered to at least one device.

signal.name: drive_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the world drive is written through the [WorldDrive] API.
